**Best all-around kit: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200W solar panel.** It pairs a 2,073.6Wh battery with a foldable panel—a useful balance for powering everyday van essentials like a 12V fridge and laptop. The listing shows it at $1,199, or $1,139.05 with its listed code; [check the kit](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2-200w-solar-kit). ([Kit details and pricing](https://dealectric.com/best-solar-generator-kit-for-van-life))

One caveat: the kit’s car socket is listed at just 96W, so don’t count on it for fast charging while driving. If keeping weight down matters more than having a larger battery, the [Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2](https://powersized.com/best/rv/) is a lighter van-focused pick: 24.9 lb, 1,024Wh, and up to 600W solar input.
